resources.string: That wasn\'t the password. Try again.
Before a sign-in or an approval goes to the Mac, Windows Hello asks for your face, fingerprint or PIN. Don\'t ask: anyone at this computer can approve.

Before a sign-in or an approval goes to the Mac, aOS asks for your password: in the system\'s dialog (polkit), or in aOS itself (checked by the system, PAM). Don\'t ask: anyone at this computer can approve.
On this system aOS can\'t ask for a confirmation: approvals go out with a click.
Keep running when the window closes
aOS then stays connected in the tray (the notification area): requests arrive as notifications. Quit it from the tray icon\'s menu.
Encrypted for your Windows account (DPAPI); the SSH key is kept by Windows itself (TPM or the Windows key storage) and can\'t be exported.
Encrypted with a key in your keyring (Secret Service) and only readable by your user account (0600).
No keyring (Secret Service) was found: the key and the secrets are in files only your user account can read (0600), not encrypted.
